role: Physics-grade structure surface: the only urban geometry the env may collide with.
outputs: versioned immutable obstacle raster (ground, top, height, coverage, building, uncertainty)
decision: Rasterise structures to a 10 m grid (592 x 546) inside the documented urban physics box, keep coverage explicit, and refuse to run the theatre without it.
rationale: 3DEP is a bare-earth surface, so cities are invisible to line of sight and collision without a separate structure layer. Public-domain lidar gives measured structure tops; cells are conservative (any structure in the cell blocks it) and unknown cells stay unknown rather than becoming open air or zero-height buildings. Presentation geometry (OSM, provider tiles) is a different cache namespace and never substitutes.

invariants: Loaded only through naigos.data.urban_obstacles.load_urban_obstacles with an ExpectedFrame.
A missing, partial or corrupt artifact is an error for this theatre; there is no fallback.
Unknown cells (coverage 0) are NaN, never zero-height buildings.
No OSM, provider-tile or screenshot-derived geometry enters this artifact.
caveats: Lidar is a capture-date snapshot (see sources[].captured); it is not current conditions.
Structure heights are per-cell maxima at the stated resolution: thin spires and masts are lower bounds, and a 10 m cell cannot resolve street canyons or building gaps narrower than a cell.
Point classification (building, bridge deck, ground) is the data provider's.
Protected-zone exclusions are no-data, so those areas are unknown rather than open.
